events.title: Will the Fed cut rates by July 2026 FOMC?
events.description: Resolves YES if the U.S. Federal Reserve announces a rate cut at or before the July 2026 FOMC meeting.

events.title: Will Democrats control the U.S. House after 2026 midterms?
events.description: Resolves YES if the Democratic Party holds 218 or more seats in the U.S. House of Representatives following the 2026 midterm elections.

events.title: Will Bitcoin close above $120,000 by September 30, 2026?
events.description: Resolves YES if BTC/USD daily close on Coinbase is at least $120,000 on or before Sept 30, 2026.

events.title: Will Keir Starmer remain UK Prime Minister through end of 2026?
events.description: Resolves YES if Keir Starmer is still serving as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom on Dec 31, 2026.

events.title: Will a 1T+ parameter open-source LLM be released in 2026?
events.description: Resolves YES if any organization publicly releases an open-weight LLM with at least one trillion parameters before Dec 31, 2026.

events.title: Will the U.S. enter a recession in 2026?
events.description: Resolves YES if NBER declares a recession with start date in calendar year 2026.

events.title: Will SpaceX successfully complete a Starship orbital refuel by Q4 2026?
events.description: Resolves YES if SpaceX demonstrates a successful Starship-to-Starship orbital propellant transfer before Dec 31, 2026.

events.title: Will the Supreme Court issue a Section 230 reform ruling in 2026?
events.description: Resolves YES if SCOTUS issues a substantive ruling that materially modifies Section 230 protections in 2026.

events.title: Did OpenAI release GPT-5 before March 2026?
events.description: Resolved YES on Feb 18, 2026 with the public launch of GPT-5.

events.title: Did the S&P 500 close above 5500 on Dec 31, 2025?
events.description: Resolved NO. S&P 500 closed below 5500 on Dec 31, 2025.
